pages.text: A moving cart passed through the alley. A new neighbor had arrived.
Mom wrapped a little bundle of bread. "I'll go and say hello." Coco raised a hand.
Mrs. Magpie called from the roof. "The new neighbor? The house with the round door!"
Coco knocked on the round door. It creaked open. The house was empty.
"Then the low door!" Grandpa Mole came out of the low door. "I'm not the new neighbor."
Mrs. Magpie tilted her head this way and that. "I'm sure it was this alley..."
Coco shifted the bundle in their arms. The smell of warm bread drifted out.
A door opened a crack. A tiny nose poked out and sniffed.
"I smelled something delicious." The new neighbor's child peeped out.
Coco handed over the bundle. The new neighbor lived right below Mrs. Magpie. Her beak fell open.
